propositions: A new advisory, agent-tier container criterion 'decomp-shape' must be added to detect layer-cake decomposition smells (children partitioned by architectural layer instead of vertical slices) and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge patterns (siblings with name-dependencies but no ordering edges).

The criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED) with facet 'container', routed in criteria_routing.json with exec AGENT, default posture advisory, and scope container.

The criterion must integrate into the existing CONTAINER_CRITERIA fan-out in pass1.py via pass1_container without new engine passes, using two sub-answers: has_container_decomposition (gate) and decomposition_shape_sound (finding).
The eval_solver container arm must be extended to run container criteria over fixtures with a children list, enabling bounded sanity runs via rebar criteria eval.

Sanity fixtures (4 hand-authored plans: 2 positives for layer-cake and consumed-artifact patterns, 2 negatives for vertical-slice and ordered decompositions) must achieve 1.0 recall on positives and 0.0 false-accept on negatives.
Blocking promotion is deferred pending E6 order-stability improvement (fleiss_kappa >= 0.6) plus dogfood-gated effectiveness validation; advisory posture ships immediately.
